notes: *after that* is taken as one compound temporal conjunction on the `בְּ`, which rule 52 also supports by giving the complementizer of a finite recasting to the preposition; the competing reading treats *that* as an added subordinator under rule 55.
The ethical dative `לְךָ` goes wholly unrendered, so both the preposition and its suffix are their own `unrepresented` units (rules 40, 22).
